comment: Same as slow_corner.bands.json, but every own-feedback route is slow (1300-1500 ps): longer than the shortest response of the next stage (c_i -> r_{i+1} route, LUT1, route, LUT, route back to c_i's I1: 3*360 + 2*99 = 1278 ps). Used to show what the audit reports when a C-element's feedback is slower than its neighbour.
